title: Planning Commission appointment fight and lawsuit
summary: On Feb. 21, 2025, the council rejected another Maui Planning Commission nominee on a 5-4 vote, and a department said the commission cannot proceed with filling seats. Quorum problems had already stalled a July 2024 commission meeting, with only six of nine members appointed. A lawsuit over a volunteer appointment led the council to cancel some appointments after a court order, and nominees were sent back to committee.

timeline.text: On a 5-4 roll call vote, the council rejected a nominee to the Maui Planning Commission.
